instruction: Cinematic wide shot of a bright, minimalist indoor room with wooden floors and large arched windows. On the left, the man with the bandana (R2) wearing a dark jumpsuit and red sneakers lifts one end of a large green velvet sofa. On the right, the man with the afro (R1) in a dark t-shirt and dark pants lifts the opposite end. The two men carry the heavy sofa together, facing each other in profile as they lift. Bright natural daylight streams through the windows, casting soft shadows on the wooden floor.
